description: Full data-import flow over the TmImportWizard shell: upload CSV/XLSX (dialect + encoding selectors, auto-detected delimiter, pluggable parsers by file extension), preview, column-to-schema mapping with auto-mapping and required/duplicate gating, batched dry-run validation with a downloadable error report (rows + reasons), and a batched import with progress, partial import (skip invalid rows), failed-rows CSV download for a corrected follow-up import, and per-session rollback — all through IDataImportTarget.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: Destination of the import: target schema, validation, batches, rollback. Required.

parameters.name: Parsers
parameters.description: Parsers by lower-case file extension (e.g. ".xlsx" → XlsxImportFileParser from Tempo.Blazor.DataTableXlsx). ".csv"/".txt" fall back to the built-in CSV parser.

parameters.name: ParseOptions
parameters.description: Parse options override. Null uses the upload step's dialect and encoding selectors.

parameters.name: BatchSize
parameters.description: Rows per provider batch for validation and import. Default is 500.

parameters.name: PreviewRowCount
parameters.description: Rows shown in the upload preview. Default is 10.

parameters.name: OnCompleted
parameters.description: Callback invoked when an import run finishes, with the run summary.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
